summary: Iteration 6 polish verified end-to-end. Backend 17/17 pytest cases pass covering: (A) Mute cap — POST /circles/{id}/members/{uid}/mute with minutes=999999 clamps muted_until to <= now+7d (and >= now+7d-60s), minutes=-5 clamps to +1m, POST .../remove with 999999 clamps banned_until to <= now+7d and the ban still blocks rejoin (403); (B) muted_until exposure — GET /circles/{id}/members returns the exact muted_until ISO string for the muted member, null for owner/non-muted members, and reverts to null after /unmute (muted bool mirror still correct); (C) Event timestamp normalization — POST /circles/{id}/events with starts_at='2026-11-01T10:00:00+05:30' and '2026-12-15T08:00:00Z' both come back with +00:00 offset and no 'Z', same instant preserved, GET /circles/{id}/events ordering ascending by starts_at remains correct across mixed-tz inputs, GET /events/upcoming also returns +00:00-normalized strings; (D) Regression — login+feed 200 w/ author_is_supporter bool on items, create-post/like/comment chain returns author_is_supporter on both post and comment, owner-immune (400) for mute+remove, non-mod gets 403, muted user is blocked from POST /posts and /posts/{id}/comments (403 each), banned user cannot rejoin (403), self-gift still 400. Frontend smoke (390x844, Expo web): login as guide works; Home feed renders with like/comment/gift buttons; Circles (Discover) screen shows 13 category chips all 44px tall (All=49x44, Writing=78x44, Wellness=90x44 — no clipping, horizontally scrollable), tapping chips flips active brand color, circle-search input filters cards; Wallet screen renders the new CoinIcon (terracotta disc w/ dollar-sign glyph) at both 32px (balance 'Your balance') and 24px (3 pack cards), buy-120 tap successfully added +120 coins (balance 735 -> 855); Calendar month grid loads w/ cal-prev/cal-next; Messages inbox lists conversations; Circle detail tabs tab-posts/tab-events/tab-about/tab-people all tap and switch content; Profile screen shows avatar, wallet summary, moderation queue, sign-out. No red screens. Only pre-existing console noise observed (pointerEvents, shadow*, useNativeDriver, Image resizeMode) — carried over from earlier iters, not introduced by this round.

action_items: Nice-to-have: emit muted_until (full ISO) in the mute response AND the members GET so the client can show 'muted until Nov 7, 3:14 PM' — already shipped in this iter; consider surfacing it in the manage-mute sheet toast as well.
Pre-existing from iter3/iter4: /api/gifts has no DB transaction between sender debit and recipient credit — crash between the two writes could burn/leak coins. Wrap in a Mongo session transaction.
Pre-existing: server.py is now 1584 lines — overdue to split into routers (auth, circles, moderation, events, posts, gifts, wallet, rooms, messages).
Pre-existing deprecations in RN Web layer — migrate pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents, shadow* -> boxShadow, Image style.resizeMode -> props.resizeMode. Non-blocking console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: clamp_minutes(min=1) silently converts non-positive input into a 1-minute mute — the API returns 200 even for minutes=0 or -5. Fine for now, but a 4xx on < 1 might communicate intent better than silent clamp.

norm_iso() falls back to the raw value on parse errors — a malformed starts_at (e.g. '2026-13-99') would persist as-is, then compare lexicographically in /events/upcoming and misbehave. Consider raising 422 on parse failure or validating with Pydantic field_validator.

GET /circles/{id}/members returns muted_until only when currently muted; a stale (expired) muted_until is correctly hidden, but the underlying membership doc still carries the past timestamp forever (no cleanup). Minor DB bloat, no correctness issue.

server.py:570 still orders events via lexicographic ISO sort; now safe for new writes thanks to norm_iso, but legacy pre-iter6 events (stored with mixed offsets) will still mis-sort. Consider a one-time migration: db.events.update_many to re-normalize existing starts_at.
